title: React Certification Core Check
description: Check your readiness for React certification concepts, final assessment structure, capstone expectations, rubrics, and mock interview preparation.
author: DailyCoder

questions.prompt: What does the certification overview expect you to demonstrate?

options.text: React fundamentals, project delivery, debugging, and explanation of tradeoffs

questions.explanation: Certification readiness combines concepts, implementation, debugging, and communication.

questions.prompt: What is one purpose of the final concept assessment?

options.text: Verify understanding of React concepts and reasoning

questions.explanation: The final assessment includes a concept portion to test understanding beyond code completion.

questions.prompt: What should a coding assessment evaluate?

options.text: Working React behavior, state handling, edge cases, and code clarity

questions.explanation: Coding assessment focuses on building correct, understandable React behavior.

questions.prompt: Which evidence is useful for capstone submission? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Private secrets committed to prove deployment

questions.explanation: Capstone evidence should demonstrate function, setup, reasoning, and validation without exposing secrets.

questions.prompt: What is a rubric used for?
questions.explanation: Rubrics make assessment criteria explicit and consistent.

questions.prompt: What is a common readiness gap before certification?

options.text: Knowing APIs but struggling to explain tradeoffs and debug failures

questions.explanation: The overview highlights gaps in explanation, debugging, and applying knowledge, not just syntax recall.

questions.prompt: What should a remediation plan do?

options.text: Identify weak areas and assign focused practice before retrying

questions.explanation: Remediation turns feedback into targeted study and practice.

questions.prompt: Mock interview readiness includes explaining decisions, responding to follow-ups, and debugging under constraints.
questions.explanation: The certification module includes mock interview readiness and debugging scenarios as part of final preparation.
